description: New Brunswick Road Network (NBRN) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. The NBRN is the official source for road data in New Brunswick. The NBRN includes road centerlines, road names, road class, surface type, address ranges and other road attributes. Coverage: Government of New Brunswick. The portal files it under the publisher Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Its tags are map, Geonb, roads, road network, routes. It offers 5 resource(s) in FGDB/GDB, GIF, HTML, OTHER, SHP. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - New Brunswick. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
